content: entproto generates .proto FROM ent schemas; it does not inject entities INTO the ent graph. The actual precedent for injecting a new generated entity into the ent graph is enthistory: a two-step process where (1) enthistory.Generate() runs schemast-based codegen writing new schema/*_history.go files to disk BEFORE entc.Generate runs, then (2) a normal entc.Extension wires behavior onto those now-real schema files during the standard entc.Generate pass. Injection is disk-based (two full codegen passes), not an in-memory gen.Graph mutation.
